name: kimi-quota-statusline
description: Native Kimi model/context status plus official 5h and 7d quotas, with monthly fallback
author: guo

interface.shortDescription: Model, context, 5h and 7d quotas with monthly fallback
interface.longDescription: Preserves the native model | ctx | win | used status and appends official 5h and 7d quota bars. If 7d is unavailable, shows the monthly total as mo. No hooks, local server, session transcript access, or non-TUI requests. A short-lived refresh runs only while the TUI invokes the status line and shares a 90-second cache across terminals.
